description: This file contains the PHP source code defining the 'Report' controller class within the OpenCart admin module. It manages the display and organization of report-related data, including loading language files, models, and rendering the report view with breadcrumbs, reports list, and other UI components.

classes.name: Report
classes.description: Controller class for managing report-related UI and data in the OpenCart admin panel.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Handles the display of the report page, including loading language files, setting breadcrumbs, fetching report modules, sorting them, and rendering the report view.
